about: A screenshot takes 20 to 60 s in software, so read the canvas (5 to 10 s; below Leaf 20 to 35 s even after __maple.res(0.5)). Run one capture at a time. A small sheet hides breaks here: also look at phone size at twice the sharpness. Hash: z=2&s=0.56&at=vacuole.

sets.name: zoom-summer
sets.note: Tree to Leaf to Tissue in summer. Expect: the date holds still, the leaf keeps its place and color, and the cut is one flat cut.
